title_quote: The market opens at eight today.

youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Farmers Market
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用農夫市集情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從逛攤問價、嚐鮮推薦、稱重砍價到買花買蛋打包聊天，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Farmers Market phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering browsing stalls, tasting fresh produce, weighing and bargaining, and buying flowers, eggs and homemade goods. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The market opens at eight today.
dialogue.zh: 市集今天八點開門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And we're here right on time.
dialogue.zh: 而我們正好準點趕到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything smells so fresh today.
dialogue.zh: 今天一切聞起來都好新鮮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The greens were cut this morning.
dialogue.zh: 青菜都是今天早上剛割的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how much are these tomatoes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, haʊ mʌtʃ ɑr ðiz təˈmeɪtoʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，這些番茄多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three dollars a pound, sir.
dialogue.zh: 先生，一磅三美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I squeeze them gently?
dialogue.zh: 我可以輕輕捏一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, no rush at all.
dialogue.zh: 可以呀，不用趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These feel a bit too firm.
dialogue.zh: 這些感覺有點太硬了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the crate behind you instead.
dialogue.zh: 試試您身後那一筐吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, these are perfectly ripe.
dialogue.zh: 哇，這些熟得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pile sells out fast, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt paɪl sɛlz aʊt fæst, trʌst mi./
dialogue.zh: 那堆賣得特別快，相信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take four of these ripe ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk fɔr ʌv ðiz raɪp wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 給我四個這種熟的吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Getting anything else today?
dialogue.zh: 今天還要買別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are those green bundles?
dialogue.zh: 那些紮成捆的綠葉是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh basil, great with pasta.
dialogue.zh: 新鮮羅勒，配意麵很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for one bunch of basil?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fər wʌn bʌntʃ ʌv ˈbæzəl?/
dialogue.zh: 一束羅勒多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two dollars, picked today.
dialogue.zh: 只要兩美元，今天現摘的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll grab one bunch, please.
dialogue.zh: 我要拿一束，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want the salad lettuce too?
dialogue.zh: 沙拉生菜也要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How fresh is this lettuce?
dialogue.zh: 這生菜有多新鮮？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut at dawn, still almost cold.
dialogue.zh: 清晨割的，摸上去還涼涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's exactly what I want.
dialogue.zh: 這正是我要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it in the bag yourself.
dialogue.zh: 您自己裝進袋子就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These cucumbers look so crisp.
dialogue.zh: 這些黃瓜看起來好脆嫩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're local, not from far away.
dialogue.zh: 都是本地產的，不是外地運來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you grow them?
dialogue.zh: 你們在哪兒種的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small farm, just twenty minutes away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl fɑrm, dʒʌst ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 小農場，開車二十分鐘就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the great smell.
dialogue.zh: 難怪味道這麼好聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smell a melon before you buy.
dialogue.zh: 買蜜瓜前記得先聞一聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one smells sweet already.
dialogue.zh: 這個已經聞著很甜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it, listen for a hollow sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt, ˈlɪsən fər ə ˈhɑloʊ saʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 敲一敲，聽聽有沒有空洞聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, this one sounds perfect.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這個聽起來正合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You picked the best one today.
dialogue.zh: 您挑到了今天最好的一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell melons by the piece?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ˈmɛlənz baɪ ðə pis?/
dialogue.zh: 蜜瓜是按個賣的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, five dollars for big ones.
dialogue.zh: 是的，大的每個五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One melon is plenty for us.
dialogue.zh: 一個蜜瓜我們就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want me to wrap it up?
dialogue.zh: 要我幫您包起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, and no plastic if possible.
dialogue.zh: 好，可以的話別用塑料袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have paper bags right here.
dialogue.zh: 我這兒就有紙袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A paper bag works great, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 紙袋挺好的，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, hold it steady.
dialogue.zh: 給您，捧穩當點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's move to the berry table.
dialogue.zh: 咱們到漿果那一桌看看吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The strawberries are ripe right now.
dialogue.zh: 草莓現在正是最好吃的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these strawberries organic?
dialogue.zh: 這些草莓是有機的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red boxes are, the blue aren't.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd ˈbɑksɪz ɑr, ðə blu ˈɑrnt./
dialogue.zh: 紅盒的是，藍盒的不是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the difference in price?
dialogue.zh: 價格差多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Organic costs two dollars more.
dialogue.zh: 有機的貴兩美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll try the organic box.
dialogue.zh: 我試試有機的那盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart choice, they taste sweeter.
dialogue.zh: 明智的選擇，它們嚐起來更甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have blueberries today?
dialogue.zh: 今天有藍莓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two boxes left, fresh from the north field.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɑksɪz lɛft, frɛʃ frʌm ðə nɔrθ fild./
dialogue.zh: 還剩兩盒，北邊田裡剛摘的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for both boxes?
dialogue.zh: 兩盒一起多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight if you take the pair.
dialogue.zh: 兩盒一起算八美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, I'll take both boxes.
dialogue.zh: 成交，兩盒我都要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're perfect on morning toast.
dialogue.zh: 抹在早餐吐司上絕配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My kids love mashed blueberries.
dialogue.zh: 我家孩子最愛壓爛的藍莓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab a third, it's practically free.
dialogue.zh: 再拿一盒吧，幾乎等於白送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, our fridge is already full.
dialogue.zh: 不了，我們家冰箱已經塞滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough, berries keep badly.
dialogue.zh: 也有道理，漿果不耐放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wash them before storing?
dialogue.zh: 存放前要先洗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait till eating, they mold fast.
dialogue.zh: 吃之前再洗，它們很容易發黴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, I used to wash first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp, aɪ ˈjʊst tə wɑʃ fərst./
dialogue.zh: 好建議，我以前總是先洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you know the berry rule.
dialogue.zh: 現在您懂漿果的規矩啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That apple stall has big crowds.
dialogue.zh: 那個蘋果攤擠了好多人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their honeycrisp apples are famous.
dialogue.zh: 他們家的蜜脆蘋果出了名的好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is waiting in line worth it?
dialogue.zh: 排隊值得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust me, one bite convinces you.
dialogue.zh: 相信我，咬一口您就服了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which apples keep the longest?
dialogue.zh: 哪種蘋果放得最久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Firm ones, store them in the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /fərm wʌnz, stɔr ðɛm ɪn ðə frɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 結實的那種，放冰箱保存。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd like a bag of six.
dialogue.zh: 我想要一袋六個的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab the bag with the darkest red.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡræb ðə bæɡ wɪð ðə ˈdɑrkɪst rɛd./
dialogue.zh: 拿那袋顏色最紅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do peaches bruise during the trip?
dialogue.zh: 桃子在路上會壓傷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nest them last in your basket.
dialogue.zh: 把桃子最後放進籃子就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good plan, soft fruit on top.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，軟水果放最上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're learning the market quickly.
dialogue.zh: 您越來越懂怎麼逛市集了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are those fuzzy brown fruits?
dialogue.zh: 那些毛茸茸的棕色水果是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kiwifruit, tart and full of vitamin C.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkiˌwiˌfrut, tɑrt ænd fʊl ʌv ˈvaɪtəmɪn si./
dialogue.zh: 奇異果，酸酸的，維C超多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've never bought a whole kiwi.
dialogue.zh: 我從沒買過整顆奇異果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy four, they ripen on the sill.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ fɔr, ðeɪ ˈraɪpən ɑn ðə sɪl./
dialogue.zh: 買四個，放窗台上就能放熟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I love sunny window fruit.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我就愛曬著太陽的水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next stop, the sweet corn stand.
dialogue.zh: 下一站，甜玉米攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Corn at a summer market, yes please.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔrn æt ə ˈsʌmər ˈmɑrkɪt, jɛs pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 夏天的市集有玉米？一定要來點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We steam it right behind the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stim ɪt raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 我們就在桌子後面現蒸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the sweet corn ready now?
dialogue.zh: 甜玉米現在好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh batch just came out, hot.
dialogue.zh: 新的一鍋剛出爐，還燙呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you sell your corn?
dialogue.zh: 你們玉米怎麼賣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two for one dollar, ears shucked.
dialogue.zh: 一美元兩根，皮都剝好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take four ears, please.
dialogue.zh: 我要四根，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter and salt included free.
dialogue.zh: 黃油和鹽免費附贈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, peaches stacked in crates.
dialogue.zh: 看，桃子一筐筐堆著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peach season only lasts weeks.
dialogue.zh: 桃子季只有短短幾個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pick my own peaches?
dialogue.zh: 我能自己挑桃子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, handle them gently.
dialogue.zh: 請便，輕點兒拿哦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A ripe peach gives just slightly.
dialogue.zh: 熟桃子按下去微微發軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, hard ones need two days.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，硬的還得放兩天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take six, some soft, some firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk siks, sʌm sɔft sʌm fərm./
dialogue.zh: 我要六個，有軟也有硬的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the smart way to buy them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə smɑrt weɪ tu baɪ ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 這才是聰明的買法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really know your fruit.
dialogue.zh: 您對水果真有研究。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come try our sample table.
dialogue.zh: 來我們的試吃桌嚐嚐吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's your proudest crop this season?
dialogue.zh: 這一季您最得意的作物是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hands down, these organic cherry tomatoes.
dialogue.zh: 毫無疑問，是這些有機小番茄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Organic? Do they cost extra?
dialogue.zh: 有機的？要加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one dollar more per basket.
dialogue.zh: 每籃只多一美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I taste before buying one?
dialogue.zh: 能先嚐再買嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By all means, try these three.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，先嚐這三顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These pop with sweet flavor.
dialogue.zh: 這些小番茄一口爆汁，甜得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And that's why people keep coming back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðæts waɪ ˈpipəl kip ˈkʌmɪŋ bæk./
dialogue.zh: 所以大家才會一趟又一趟地來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What makes them taste so good?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼它們這麼好吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real sun and no chemical sprays.
dialogue.zh: 充足的陽光，從不打化學藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your farm certified organic?
dialogue.zh: 你們的農場有有機認證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, see the sticker on the sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, si ðə ˈstɪkər ɑn ðə saɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 有啊，看到招牌上的貼紙了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I didn't notice that little badge.
dialogue.zh: 我沒注意到那個小標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It took us three years to get it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tʊk ʌs θri jɪrz tu ɡɛt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們花了三年才拿到認證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's worth every extra dollar.
dialogue.zh: 那每一分加價都值了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Want to hear what's in season?
dialogue.zh: 想聽聽現在什麼是當季嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, tell me your top picks.
dialogue.zh: 請告訴我您最推薦的幾樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zucchini, peaches, sweet corn, basil.
dialogue.zh: 櫛瓜、桃子、甜玉米、羅勒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is zucchini cheap this time of year?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz zʊˈkɑni tʃip ðɪs taɪm ʌv jɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這個時節的櫛瓜便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two small ones for one dollar.
dialogue.zh: 兩個小的只要一美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are they priced so low?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼定價這麼低？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too many came in this week.
dialogue.zh: 這周到貨實在太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you suggest a good recipe?
dialogue.zh: 能推薦一個好做法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grill the zucchini with olive oil.
dialogue.zh: 抹點橄欖油烤一烤就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds easy enough for me.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來我這水平也做得來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my ten minute dinner trick.
dialogue.zh: 這是我十分鐘搞定晚餐的絕招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you got anything new to try?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju ɡɑt ˈɛniˌθɪŋ nju tə traɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 有什麼新鮮東西可以嚐嚐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh goat cheese, right this way.
dialogue.zh: 新鮮山羊起司，這邊請。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheese at a farmers market?
dialogue.zh: 農夫市集上還有起司？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our neighbor farm makes it by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈneɪbər fɑrm meɪks ɪt baɪ hænd./
dialogue.zh: 是隔壁農場手工做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I sample a small cube?
dialogue.zh: 我能嘗一小塊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, with a honey drizzle.
dialogue.zh: 當然，上面淋了點蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is creamy but light.
dialogue.zh: 口感綿密，卻很清爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll love it on warm bread.
dialogue.zh: 配熱麵包您會更愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What fruit do you recommend most?
dialogue.zh: 您最推薦哪種水果？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: White peaches, but only today.
dialogue.zh: 白桃，不過只有今天有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why only today?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼只有今天有？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We only picked enough for today.
dialogue.zh: 我們只摘了夠今天賣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've never seen white peaches.
dialogue.zh: 我從沒見過白皮的桃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They taste less sour, try one.
dialogue.zh: 它們沒那麼酸，嘗一個看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their skin looks soft, like velvet.
dialogue.zh: 果皮看起來像天鵝絨一樣軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub it gently before you eat.
dialogue.zh: 吃之前輕輕搓一搓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two white peaches it is, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 好，來兩個白桃，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick this heavy one, full of juice.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ðɪs ˈhɛvi wʌn, fʊl ʌv dʒus./
dialogue.zh: 挑這個沉的，汁水最足。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's that strange green squash?
dialogue.zh: 那個奇怪綠色的瓜是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bitter melon, a taste you grow into.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪtər ˈmɛlən, ə teɪst ju ɡroʊ ˈɪntu./
dialogue.zh: 苦瓜，味道要慢慢才會喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it really that bitter?
dialogue.zh: 它真的那麼苦嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salt it first, then it's mild.
dialogue.zh: 先抹鹽，苦味就淡多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mother used to cook it.
dialogue.zh: 我媽媽以前常煮這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one home, taste those summer days.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk wʌn hoʊm, teɪst ðoʊz ˈsʌmər deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 帶一個回家，嚐嚐夏天的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a lovely way to put it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈlʌvli weɪ tu pʊt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 您這話說得真動人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Food holds memories in every bite.
dialogue.zh: 每一口食物都藏著回憶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you grow everything yourself?
dialogue.zh: 這些都是你們自己種的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly yes, plus my neighbor's honey.
dialogue.zh: 大部分是的，還有鄰居的蜂蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your neighbor keeps beehives?
dialogue.zh: 您鄰居養蜂啊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty hives behind the red barn.
dialogue.zh: 紅穀倉後面有四十箱呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flowers must make sweet honey.
dialogue.zh: 花一定釀得出很甜的蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, taste a spoon from the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, teɪst ə spun frʌm ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 來，從罐裡舀一匙嚐嚐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a light, flowery taste.
dialogue.zh: 這味道清清淡淡，還有花香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bees work the clover patch.
dialogue.zh: 蜜蜂都在三葉草叢裡採蜜呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know what's ripe right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju noʊ wʌts raɪp raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 您知道現在什麼最好吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blackberries peak this very week.
dialogue.zh: 黑莓這週正當季呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I loved picking these as a kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌvd ˈpɪkɪŋ ðiz æz ə kɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我小時候最愛採這種莓果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This pint holds the biggest berries.
dialogue.zh: 這一盒裝的都是最大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for one full pint?
dialogue.zh: 滿滿一盒多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five, but jam costs the same.
dialogue.zh: 五美元，不過果醬也是這個價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your jam is homemade too?
dialogue.zh: 果醬也是自家熬的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Made last night, the jar's still warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪd læst naɪt, ðə dʒɑrz stɪl wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 昨晚剛熬的，罐子還是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I smell the open jar?
dialogue.zh: 我能聞一下那罐開的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, low sugar, real fruit only.
dialogue.zh: 給，低糖，全是真水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This smells like my grandma's kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 這味道像我奶奶的廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'd approve of every spoon.
dialogue.zh: 她老人家看了準點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take one jam and one pint.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk wʌn dʒæm ænd wʌn paɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 我拿一瓶果醬和一盒黑莓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Toast loves both of those.
dialogue.zh: 這兩樣抹吐司都最搭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds better than a restaurant.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來比餐廳還棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresher than any restaurant, guaranteed.
dialogue.zh: 比任何餐廳都新鮮，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell ready to eat salads?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ˈrɛdi tu it ˈsælædz?/
dialogue.zh: 賣那種開袋即食的沙拉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mason jar salads, build your own.
dialogue.zh: 罐裝沙拉，您自己搭配。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Build my own? How does it work?
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪld maɪ oʊn? haʊ dʌz ɪt wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 自己配？那是怎麼弄的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick greens, add toppings, shake it.
dialogue.zh: 選底菜，加配料，搖一搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add the roasted beets?
dialogue.zh: 我可以加烤甜菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right beside the dressings.
dialogue.zh: 可以，就在醬料那一排旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which dressing do most people choose?
dialogue.zh: 大家都選哪種醬料？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lemon honey, our number one seller.
dialogue.zh: 蜂蜜檸檬，我們的銷量冠軍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take the lemon honey one.
dialogue.zh: 我要蜂蜜檸檬那一瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great pick, it wakes up any salad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt pɪk, ɪt weɪks ʌp ˈɛni ˈsælæd./
dialogue.zh: 選得好，什麼沙拉都被它提味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you also sell cut fruit cups?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɔlsoʊ sɛl kʌt frut kʌps?/
dialogue.zh: 你們也賣切好的水果杯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fruit cups live at the kids' table.
dialogue.phonetic: /frut kʌps lɪv æt ðə kɪdz ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 水果杯都在兒童桌那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which cup has the least sugar?
dialogue.zh: 哪一杯糖最少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plain melon, nothing added at all.
dialogue.zh: 純蜜瓜杯什麼都沒加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for my picky little one.
dialogue.zh: 正適合我家挑食的小寶貝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids usually finish those fast.
dialogue.zh: 小孩一般很快就吃光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the kale here tender enough?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的羽衣甘藍夠嫩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Massage it with oil, then enjoy.
dialogue.zh: 抹點油揉一揉，就好吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Massage the leaves? Really?
dialogue.zh: 還要揉葉子？真的假的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust me, ten seconds does it.
dialogue.zh: 信我，揉十秒就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You always have some clever tip.
dialogue.zh: 您總有聰明的小訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty years farming teaches a few.
dialogue.zh: 種田二十年，多少會幾招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my wallet is ready again.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我的錢包又準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow me, the weighing table's free.
dialogue.zh: 跟我來，稱重台正好空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the table for weighing?
dialogue.zh: 這裡是稱重台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set your bags right here.
dialogue.zh: 對，袋子直接放這兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These tomatoes feel heavy already.
dialogue.zh: 這些番茄掂著就已經挺沉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's see, two pounds and change.
dialogue.zh: 我看看，兩磅還多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does that number say?
dialogue.zh: 那個數字寫的是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three a pound, so a few more.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ə paʊnd, soʊ ə fju mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 一磅三塊，所以再加幾塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take exact change?
dialogue.zh: 需要給剛好數額的錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exact helps, but I have coins.
dialogue.zh: 給剛好的最好，不過我也有零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay by phone instead?
dialogue.zh: 我可以改用手機的付款嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just scan my QR code.
dialogue.zh: 可以，掃我的二維碼就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, the app said payment sent.
dialogue.zh: 好了，手機程式顯示付款成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, thank you kindly.
dialogue.zh: 收到啦，太感謝您了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This scale looks old but works.
dialogue.zh: 這台秤看著舊，但很好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It never fooled a single customer.
dialogue.zh: 它從沒坑過任何一個客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you weigh these peppers separately?
dialogue.zh: 這些辣椒能單獨稱一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, two pounds one, no problem.
dialogue.zh: 好，兩磅多一點，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the paper bags count as weight?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈpeɪpər bæɡz kaʊnt æz weɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 紙袋的重量會算進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we always deduct the bags.
dialogue.zh: 不會，我們一向扣掉袋子重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's honest, I notice these things.
dialogue.zh: 太實在啦，這種小細節我都放在心上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honesty brings my buyers back.
dialogue.zh: 誠實才能留住老買主。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The peaches weigh just over three.
dialogue.zh: 桃子剛好超過三磅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's call it three, round down.
dialogue.zh: 就算三磅吧，往下取整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'd lose money like that?
dialogue.zh: 那樣您不是要虧錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little discount keeps friends close.
dialogue.zh: 讓點小利，才留得住熟客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you give me a better price?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ɡiv mi ə ˈbɛtər praɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 能給我便宜一點點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much were you hoping to pay?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ wɜr ju ˈhoʊpɪŋ tə peɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 您心裡想付多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four dollars feels fair for these.
dialogue.zh: 四美元我覺得挺公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You drive a hard bargain, friend.
dialogue.zh: 您真會講價啊，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I come every Saturday, remember?
dialogue.zh: 我每週六都來，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A regular? Fine, four dollars.
dialogue.zh: 老主顧啊？行，四美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, you just made my morning.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，您一早就讓我開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell your friends about the deal.
dialogue.zh: 把這筆好買賣告訴朋友哦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you offer bundle prices?
dialogue.zh: 你們有打包價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy three bags, pay for two.
dialogue.zh: 買三袋只收兩袋的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a real market steal.
dialogue.zh: 這可真是撿到大便宜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the third one, the bin's nearly empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə θərd wʌn, ðə bɪnz ˈnɪrli ˈɛmpti./
dialogue.zh: 拿第三袋吧，筐裡快清空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bundle the peppers, then.
dialogue.zh: 那我就把辣椒也湊一袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mixing colors always looks cheerful.
dialogue.zh: 紅綠混著裝，看著就喜慶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this is your final price?
dialogue.zh: 所以這已是您的底價了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the greens, yes, that's my final word.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər ðə ɡrinz, jɛs, ðæts maɪ ˈfaɪnəl wərd./
dialogue.zh: 青菜這邊真的不能再讓了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alright, I won't push more.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我不再多還價了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take this bunch of dill, on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, teɪk ðɪs bʌntʃ ʌv dɪl, ɑn mi./
dialogue.zh: 來，這把蒔蘿送您，別客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free herbs? You never fail me.
dialogue.zh: 免費香草？您從沒讓我失望過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Regulars get my little bonuses.
dialogue.zh: 熟客總有我的一點小心意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I swap the bitter melon for zucchini?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ swɑp ðə ˈbɪtər ˈmɛlən fər zʊˈkɑni?/
dialogue.zh: 我能把苦瓜換成櫛瓜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, same weight, no trouble.
dialogue.zh: 當然，重量一樣，不麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I take the whole crate?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ teɪk ðə hoʊl kreɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我把整筐都端走呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'd drop it to twenty.
dialogue.zh: 那我就算您二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make it eighteen and it's done.
dialogue.zh: 十八成交，怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! Eighteen, put it there.
dialogue.zh: 成交！十八塊，放這邊吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love closing a quick deal.
dialogue.zh: 我就喜歡這樣痛快的買賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fast deals bring you back faster.
dialogue.zh: 交易越爽快，您回來越勤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do prices drop near closing time?
dialogue.zh: 快收攤的時候價錢會降嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After two, half price on greens.
dialogue.zh: 兩點以後，青菜半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the later, the cheaper here.
dialogue.zh: 也就是說在這兒越晚越便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the pick gets thinner too.
dialogue.zh: 可是剩的好貨也越來越少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll risk it for a bargain.
dialogue.zh: 為了便宜，我願意冒個險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come back, I'll set greens aside.
dialogue.zh: 回頭來吧，我給您留一把。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this discount only for today?
dialogue.zh: 這個折扣只有今天才有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only today, market ends at five.
dialogue.zh: 只有今天，市集五點收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I must hurry and decide.
dialogue.zh: 那我得趕緊做決定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll hold these tomatoes for you.
dialogue.zh: 這些番茄我先給您留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a star, I'll be quick.
dialogue.zh: 您真是大好人，我快去快回。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rush, I'm not going anywhere.
dialogue.zh: 不急，我又不會走開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that bag of beans fall?
dialogue.zh: 那袋豆子剛才是掉了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but they're still good inside.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，不過裡面的都還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take them with a discount.
dialogue.zh: 便宜一點的話我就收下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them half off, no fuss.
dialogue.zh: 半價拿走，別客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these figs priced per pound?
dialogue.zh: 無花果是按磅計價的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, by the flat, four dollars.
dialogue.zh: 不，按盒賣，四美元一盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat means a shallow box, right?
dialogue.zh: 「盒」是指扁扁的淺盒子，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, a market word for you.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，送您一個市集行話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does marked down mean?
dialogue.zh: 「降價」標記是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The seller cut it, grab one fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɛlər kʌt ɪt, ɡræb wʌn fæst./
dialogue.zh: 賣家自己降了價，快挑一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you match the next stall's price?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju mætʃ ðə nɛkst stɔləz praɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 您能給到隔壁攤那個價嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me that tag and I'll see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðæt tæɡ ænd aɪl si./
dialogue.zh: 把那張價籤拿給我看，我再考慮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, their lettuce is cheaper.
dialogue.zh: 您看，他們的生菜便宜些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine's organic, theirs isn't.
dialogue.zh: 我的是有機的，他們不是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ah, that answers that question.
dialogue.zh: 啊，那這問題就有答案了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good quality speaks for itself.
dialogue.zh: 好品質自己會說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll pay full price for good lettuce.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl peɪ fʊl praɪs fər ɡʊd ˈlɛtɪs./
dialogue.zh: 好生菜我願意付原價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You learn fast, future regular.
dialogue.zh: 學得真快，未來的熟客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two potatoes, or two dollars?
dialogue.zh: 是賣兩個馬鈴薯，還是兩美元？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two dollars for the whole sack.
dialogue.zh: 兩美元買一整麻袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sack looks heavy to carry.
dialogue.zh: 這麻袋看著挺難拎的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tie it strong, easy grip.
dialogue.zh: 我幫您繫牢，好上手拎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it cheaper in the last hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈtʃipər ɪn ðə læst ˈaʊər?/
dialogue.zh: 最後一個小時會更便宜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Baskets half price after four.
dialogue.zh: 四點以後籃子都半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll return at half past four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl rɪˈtərn æt hæf pæst fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那我四點半再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your biggest bag, alright?
dialogue.zh: 把您最大的袋子帶來，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really want me to spend more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈrɛəli wɑnt mi tə spɛnd mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 您是真想讓我多花錢啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want you coming back weekly.
dialogue.zh: 我是想讓您每週都來呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, that's the best business.
dialogue.zh: 說得對，這才是最好的生意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, want these weighed together?
dialogue.zh: 那麼，這些要一起稱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, all into one big bag.
dialogue.zh: 好，全裝進一個大袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's eight forty on the dot.
dialogue.zh: 一分不差，八塊四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect math, I love the scale.
dialogue.zh: 這賬算得真漂亮，我愛這桿秤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scale never plays favorites.
dialogue.zh: 秤可不偏心任何人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who's waiting in the weighing line?
dialogue.zh: 稱重台前排的是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A lady with flowers, lovely.
dialogue.zh: 一位拿花的女士，真好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's visit the flower tables.
dialogue.zh: 我們去鮮花攤看看吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their sunflowers are market stars.
dialogue.zh: 他們家的向日葵是市集明星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These sunflowers make me smile.
dialogue.zh: 這些向日葵看得我想笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One fifty for a single stem.
dialogue.zh: 單買一支一塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell them in bunches?
dialogue.zh: 你們成束賣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dozen stems for fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 十二支一打，十五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's cheaper, I'll take a dozen.
dialogue.zh: 那樣划算，來一打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the stems wet, they last longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə stɛmz wɛt, ðeɪ læst ˈlɔŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 莖部保持濕潤，花就能開得久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What are those small purple ones?
dialogue.zh: 那些紫色的小花是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lavender, dried or fresh today.
dialogue.zh: 薰衣草，乾的鮮的都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dried bundles smell strong.
dialogue.zh: 乾花束的味道好濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hang one inside your closet.
dialogue.zh: 掛一支在您的衣櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any roses?
dialogue.zh: 有玫瑰花嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Garden roses, small and fragrant.
dialogue.zh: 庭院玫瑰，小小的，特別香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bunch, for my wife, please.
dialogue.zh: 請來一束，送給我太太。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's a lucky woman today.
dialogue.zh: 她今天可真是幸福。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep the eggs?
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cooler box, third row, look left.
dialogue.zh: 保溫箱，第三排，往左邊看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these from free range hens?
dialogue.zh: 這些是散養雞下的蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they roam the grass all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ roʊm ðə ɡræs ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對，它們整天在草地上跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The yolks must be deep orange.
dialogue.zh: 蛋黃一定是深橘色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crack one, you'll see tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚敲開一個，您就知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for half a dozen?
dialogue.zh: 半打多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, if you return the clean carton.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr, ɪf ju rɪˈtɜrn ðə klin ˈkɑrtən./
dialogue.zh: 四美元，前提是蛋盒洗淨退回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I check for cracked shells?
dialogue.zh: 我能檢查一下有沒有裂殼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open every carton, please do.
dialogue.zh: 每盒都可以打開，儘管查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These six are perfect, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 這六個都好，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Farm eggs skip the store wait.
dialogue.zh: 農場蛋可不等商店上架呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do eggs need refrigerating fast?
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋要趕緊放冰箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, straight onto the fridge shelf.
dialogue.zh: 要，回家直接放進冰箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the jam stand we saw earlier.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ, ðə dʒæm stænd wi sɔ ˈɜrliər./
dialogue.zh: 現在去我們早先看到的果醬攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the apricot, my favorite.
dialogue.zh: 試試杏子醬，我的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spread it on cheese, not bread.
dialogue.zh: 抹在起司上，不是麵包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you're cooking like a pro.
dialogue.zh: 您這吃法像行家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two jars, one for my sister.
dialogue.zh: 兩罐，一罐給我妹妹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peach and apricot, great pairing.
dialogue.zh: 桃子和杏子，絕配組合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this honey raw and unfiltered?
dialogue.zh: 這蜂蜜是生蜜、沒過濾的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raw, cloudy, straight from frames.
dialogue.zh: 生的、渾濁的，直接從蜂巢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One jar of wildflower honey.
dialogue.zh: 一罐百花蜜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bear bottle costs a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛr ˈbɑtəl kɔsts ə bɪt mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 小熊瓶的要多幾個錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect gift shape for my niece.
dialogue.zh: 送我姪女正合適的造型。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll lick that bear clean fast.
dialogue.zh: 她一會兒就把小熊舔乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A spoon of honey in warm milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə spun ʌv ˈhʌni ɪn wɔrm mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 一匙蜂蜜調進溫牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The oldest sleepy trick in the book.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈoʊldɪst ˈslɪpi trɪk ɪn ðə bʊk./
dialogue.zh: 這是老一輩最經典的助眠祕方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Real handmade butter? No way.
dialogue.zh: 真的是手工奶油嗎？不會吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Churned Friday, salt flakes on top.
dialogue.zh: 週五才打的，上面撒著鹽片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're making my grocery list grow.
dialogue.zh: 您讓我的購物清單越來越長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good cooks need generous shelves.
dialogue.zh: 會做飯的人架子要夠滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the wood-fired bread?
dialogue.zh: 柴火烤的麵包在哪兒？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two stalls down, follow the smell.
dialogue.zh: 往前兩個攤，跟著香味走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the round loaves still warm?
dialogue.zh: 圓麵包還溫著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last two came out an hour ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst tu keɪm aʊt ən ˈaʊər əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 最後兩個是一小時前出爐的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still perfect for tonight's soup.
dialogue.zh: 配今晚的湯還是絕妙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For soup, tear it, never cut it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr sup, tɪr ɪt, ˈnɛvər kʌt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 配湯要用手撕，別用刀切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's pack everything in my basket.
dialogue.zh: 我們把東西都裝進籃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eggs center, greens around them.
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋放中間，青菜圍四周。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a smart packing puzzle.
dialogue.zh: 這裝箱拼圖真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squash first, they're little soldiers.
dialogue.zh: 櫛瓜墊底，它們是小士兵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My basket won't close now.
dialogue.zh: 我的籃子現在怎麼也合不上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Market gravity, nobody escapes.
dialogue.zh: 市集的引力，誰也逃不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The melon needs a bag of its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɛlən nidz ə bæɡ ʌv ɪts oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 蜜瓜得單獨用一個袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Double bag it, just in case.
dialogue.zh: 套兩層袋，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we forget the fresh corn?
dialogue.zh: 我們是不是忘了鮮玉米？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already wrapped in your bag.
dialogue.zh: 早就幫您裝進袋子裡啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You remember me after all!
dialogue.zh: 您竟然還記得我！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know my Saturday faces.
dialogue.zh: 週六的老面孔我都認得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you sold here?
dialogue.zh: 您在這兒賣了多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Since my girls started walking.
dialogue.zh: 從我女兒會走路那年起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now they help at the stall?
dialogue.zh: 現在她們來攤位幫忙了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, on Sundays with homework done.
dialogue.zh: 兩個都來，週日寫完作業以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a lovely market story.
dialogue.zh: 這是個溫馨的市集故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most market stalls are family affairs.
dialogue.zh: 市集上大多數攤位都是一家人在撐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the rain hurt your crops?
dialogue.zh: 那場雨傷到你們的莊稼了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some losses, but corn loved it.
dialogue.zh: 損失了一些，不過玉米可喜歡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The parking lot is half empty.
dialogue.zh: 停車場已經空了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we're our own last customers.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就是您攤上最後的客人啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Need a hand with those heavy crates?
dialogue.phonetic: /nid ə hænd wɪð ðoʊz ˈhɛvi kreɪts?/
dialogue.zh: 那幾筐重的要我搭把手嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kind, but they're my morning workout.
dialogue.zh: 您真好，那是我每天的晨練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's coming in next week, then?
dialogue.zh: 那下週會有什麼新貨呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pumpkins, they'll be piled high.
dialogue.zh: 南瓜到時會堆得滿滿的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write it down, I keep every note.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt daʊn, aɪ kip ˈɛvri noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 寫下來吧，每張小條我都留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, here's my market card.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，這是我的市集小卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your card goes on the fridge.
dialogue.zh: 您的卡片會貼在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where all good plans live.
dialogue.zh: 好計劃全都住在這兒呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have a restful evening, friend.
dialogue.zh: 祝您晚上好好休息，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, thanks for shopping local.
dialogue.zh: 您也是，謝謝照顧本地攤位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same table next Saturday, then?
dialogue.zh: 那下週六還是同一個攤位，說定囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same table, same fresh smile.
dialogue.zh: 同一個攤子，同一張笑臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you then, bye for now.
dialogue.zh: 到時候見，先走啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The market will be here, always yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɑrkɪt wɪl bi hɪr, ˈɔlˌweɪz jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 市集會一直守候，永遠為您開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Carrying two bags nearly beat me.
dialogue.zh: 拎著兩個袋子可把我累壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My arms now count as workouts.
dialogue.zh: 我這手臂今天就算鍛鍊過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen table looks like art.
dialogue.zh: 餐桌擺得像一幅畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Market hauls always display well.
dialogue.zh: 市集提回的東西，擺著就好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner tonight is a garden tour.
dialogue.zh: 今晚的晚餐像逛了一遍菜園。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eat slowly, savor every color.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吃，品嚐每一種顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Worth every coin I spent.
dialogue.zh: 我花的每一分錢都值。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good food is never expensive.
dialogue.zh: 好東西從來不算貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll dream of peaches tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我會夢到桃子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet dreams taste like summer.
dialogue.zh: 好夢的味道，就是夏天的味道。
